description: Straßenpanoramabilder is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In 2019 and 2022, high-resolution and georeferenced 360° road panorama images were created for the urban area of Braunschweig. The recording drives were carried out by the company CycloMedia, which also collected laser scan data in parallel to the panoramic images. The street panorama images are used exclusively for internal service use. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Street panorama pictures" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Straßenpanoramabilder, Laserscan, CycloMedia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
